sentences.en: Your eyes are like round corals, dazzling and very pretty.
sentences.zh: 你的眼睛就像圆润的珊瑚，光彩夺目，非常漂亮。

sentences.en: Most corals contain algae called zooxanthellae which are plant-like organisms.
sentences.zh: 大多数珊瑚含有称为虫黄藻的藻类，这些藻类是类似植物的生物。

sentences.en: Corals are a beautiful and important part of our ocean.
sentences.zh: 珊瑚是我们海洋中美丽而重要的组成部分。
